description: If youre looking for a real estate investment with potential for development, this property offers a great opportunity to build sweat equity. This property has fire damage. The fixer-upper sits on a lot, begging for a creative redevelopment touch. Located in a convenient neighborhood close to downtown, with easy access to public transportation and freeways, its a prime spot. Don't miss your chance to transform this property into a stunning home while building equity in the process!
risks: FIRE DAMAGE mentioned in listing - the Light/Heavy rehab estimates are a standard cosmetic/full-remodel model and do NOT price in fire remediation (structural assessment, smoke/soot abatement, possible rebuild) - get a contractor/structural engineer estimate before trusting this profit number
